newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Communist leaders recommend joining govt.
newsitem.headline: French Communist leaders recommend joining govt.

text.p: Leaders of France's Communist Party, which holds the balance of power following a parliamentary election, recommended on Tuesday that it join the new Socialist-led government.

The national committee, whose views are traditionally followed by grassroots members, said it had decided to recommend joining the left's parliamentary majority and bringing Communists into the government.
The brief written statement made no reference to conditions the party might make for joining the government.
Local party members were due to discuss the issue later on Tuesday, pending a final decision on Wednesday.
The party has said it opposes a single European currency and wants wage rises for the low-paid.
Prime Minister Lionel Jospin, who took office on Tuesday, has said the Socialist party line on Europe would prevail in any government which also included ministers from other parties.
